description: Anonymous audit disclosures, one case per audit key and layout: commitment (class 4, two published inputs, both notes of the ring, no exit), commitment_exits (the same key with an exit), commitment_pair (class 4, three published inputs), commitment_wide (class 1 at 16 outputs, one published input) and entry (class 8, two published inputs, the second a default-ring note, with an exit). Encodings, fixed inputs, layout, the CRDS slot secret, the body and the blinding as in audit-disclosure-delivered.json, plus the domain tags CRAT, CRIK, CRIT, CRPK, CRPT. A ring output's tag is 16 bytes and its owner tag 0^16 || tag. An inbox tag is low128(Poseidon(CRIT, inbox_key, epoch, index)) with inbox_key = Poseidon(CRIK, ring_id, pack_be(0x04 || recipient_u)), a pair tag low128(Poseidon(CRPT, pair_key, epoch, index)) with pair_key = Poseidon(CRPK, first_contact_secret), a change tag low128 of tag_field, a dummy tag random. A ring output's ring_data_hash = Poseidon(CRAT, slot_secret, 0^16 || tag), an exit's and a dummy's 0. Every input belongs to the sender, owner Poseidon(owner identity of sender_key, sender_nullifier_pk), its data hashes zero, its commitment the UTXO hash under input_tree_id with ring id ring_id for a ring input and 0 for a default-ring input. plaintext: seed_out first when an output exits, then sender_nullifier_pk under the entry key, the nullifier_pk of every output (0 on a dummy), pack_disclosure of one 64-byte slot per output (a ring output owner_key || recipient_u, an exit asset || u64be(amount) || 0^24, a dummy zeros) behind sender_key under the entry key alone, then under the commitment key the commitment of input 0 and one field prefix(a) * 2^126 + prefix(b) per two later inputs a and b in order, prefix the first 16 bytes of a commitment read big endian and 0 past the last input, under the entry key pack_disclosure(u64be(amount) of all eight input slots, zero past the published inputs) and the asset and blinding of every published input. Under the commitment key the auditor takes the sender as the owner of input 0 among the notes it opened before, and opens every later input among the sender's notes that carry its prefix. pad, published and disclosure_chain as in audit-disclosure-delivered.json. Generated by sdk-libs/client/tests/disclosure_vectors.rs.
